source_refs.note: Conservation of Momentum: a main subheading of 2.9 Elastic collision in two dimensions, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 44-44.

blocks.text: The initial momentum of projectile before collision is m₁v⃗₁i while initial momentum of target before collision is zero. The final momentum of projectile having mass m₁ and velocity v⃗₁f after collision is m₁v⃗₁f. The final momentum of target having mass m₂ and velocity v⃗₂f after collision is m₂v⃗₂f. Resolve final momentum of projectile into components m₁v⃗₁f cosθ₁ and m₁v⃗₁f sinθ₁. Similarly, resolve the final momentum of target into components m₂v⃗₂f cosθ₂ and m₂v⃗₂f sinθ₂.

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁i - m₁v₁f cos θ₁ = m₂v₂f cos θ₂   (2.34)
Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
0 = m₁v₁f sin θ₁ - m₂v₂f sin θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂   (2.35)
